constraints: Require exactly one defined LOCAL atree_handles, atree_scroll, and whichatree before promotion and GLOBAL versions afterward; no code/data/relocation/address rewrite is performed.

Require exactly one source-defined GLOBAL STT_OBJECT each for sAtreeZero and natreelists. Do not discover, rename or promote anonymous zero objects or impose retail values, sizes or section positions on editable builds.

Matching mode may first replay the unchanged WebFrank rules using the supplied config, target and image. Editable mode omits that instruction postprocessor; the remaining three symbol promotions still run.
The three remaining large-array promotions preserve a measured source layout. Finite failed source experiments do not prove those remaining promotions universally necessary.
name: atree-exports
purpose: Promote only three measured internal-linkage atree BSS array definitions to their existing external interface; sAtreeZero and natreelists are now ordinary source-defined global objects.
